text: My office received a petition from Macaulay Avenue residents requesting that speed humps be installed on their street. The purpose of this motion is to have speed humps installed, as requested by residents on Macaulay Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened item TE32.68 entitled "Traffic Calming - Speed Humps - Macaulay Avenue", with respect to Recommendations 1 and 2. 2. Deleted the polling requirement and approve the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Macaulay. 3. Deleted Recommendation 1 of Item TE32.68 and replace it with the following new Recommendation 1: "1. Direct the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway on Macaulay Avenue, between Perth Avenue and Sousa Mendes Street, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of Drawing No. 421G-2948, dated March 2018, attached to the report entitled "Traffic Calming - Macaulay Avenue" from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District." 4. Delete Recommendation 2 of Item TE32.68.
